title: Organization validation can certify and clear an obsolete selection after the active choice changes
preconditions: The defect reproduction and delayed/reordered storage-callback coverage are deterministic unit tests in tests/unit/auth-route.test.ts; no repo-owned native network-delay fixture or callback-order interception was found.
For supporting native A/B selection evidence, use a signed-in member and admin separately, each with at least two current memberships; do not change membership data.
reproduction: Run tests/unit/auth-route.test.ts test “does not certify or clear a choice changed while validation was in flight”: it holds A validation, changes active storage to B, then releases the held read.

Run the same file’s “keeps its validated fallback when its own stale-choice notification arrives late” and “keeps a newer validated choice when an older own-clear event arrives after the choice event” tests for deterministic late/reordered own-clear callbacks.

The repo contains no owned native fixture that can hold the membership read and schedule Chrome storage callbacks. EXT-F-1015-T42/T43 therefore verify only native cross-context A/B selection persistence and request routing; they do not reproduce the pending-validation race.
expected: A validation result applies only to the organization choice it validated; a changed active choice remains current and is not cleared or certified by the stale result. Deterministic delayed/reordered callback checks are unit-only; native retest of that race remains unverified.
actual: The reproduced race allowed validation for an old organization choice to certify that choice and clear the newer active selection.
cause: The in-flight validation completion can act on mutable active-organization state without preserving the identity of the choice it began validating. The repository has deterministic unit coverage for late/reordered own-clear notifications but no native callback-order control.
severity: S2: a stale validation result can invalidate the current organization selection for signed-in members/admins
priority: P0: retain deterministic unit coverage for the original race and late/reordered callbacks, and record supporting native A/B selection checks without claiming a native race retest.
evidence: tests/unit/auth-route.test.ts: does not certify or clear a choice changed while validation was in flight
tests/unit/auth-route.test.ts: keeps its validated fallback when its own stale-choice notification arrives late
tests/unit/auth-route.test.ts: keeps a newer validated choice when an older own-clear event arrives after the choice event
